en-US.description:
Stella is a personal AI assistant for your phone and computer.

Ask questions, talk through ideas, write, and get things done. Send photos and files, use voice, or connect your computer to work with your apps and files.
en-US.title: Stella - Your AI
en-US.subtitle: Your Personal AI Assistant
en-US.releaseNotes:
• Answer Stella's questions from your phone. When Stella needs a decision or a detail to keep going, you can reply right in the chat.
• Voice conversations have been rebuilt, and there's now a setting to turn voice on or off.
• Photos, videos, and files in a conversation now appear as previews instead of plain links.
• Dictation transcribes as you speak, and tells you when it can't hear you.
• A clearer picture of what Stella is working on, including how many tasks are in progress.
• Fixes for signing out, notifications, getting started, and chat layout.

review.notes:
Sign-in is optional. Complete onboarding to start chatting.

Computer mode requires pairing with the Stella desktop app using a code. Chat responses come from the AI assistant; there is no public feed or chat between users.
